review.rationale: The decision strictly binds one portable candidate archive to one addressed owner-normalized atomic static-site deployment under a single SSH session, with explicit caps, stop conditions, and rollback limited to the captured pre-switch current. It enforces remote verification of the decision and qualifying review, safe extraction (no symlinks/hardlinks/devices/absolute/parent traversal), manifest and hash re-verification, nginx -t without reload, localhost-only route validation, and no external requests. It explicitly forbids new product release, Standard Ready, Production, commercial offering, nginx/cert/security/DNS/DBOS/SAEE changes, and credential recording. Authority boundaries are preserved: no new authority, permission, or evidence truth is created. The recommendation chain and admission evidence references are present and remote-verified, and the result contract is sufficient for a bounded deployment receipt.
